findings.statement: Authority manifest v6 names evidence-only run 33118831286 while its bound CI history v2 ends at 33116756921.
The live identity producer accepts and invokes a progress callback despite the manifest prohibition.
Canonical reviewer results predate the final readiness declaration bytes.
Qualification normalization has no committed generator binding.
The instantiability candidate digest cannot be independently reproduced because checkpoint_root and event_identity_plan_sha256 are omitted.
Requested evidence-only run 33119484879 is not bound by committed evidence.
